mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, title, COALESCE(out_amount, 0) AS outAmount, COALESCE(in_amount, 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(in_amount, 0) - COALESCE(out_amount, 0) AS profit, CASE WHEN COALESCE(out_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COALESCE(in_amount, 0) - COALESCE(out_amount, 0)) / out_amount * 100 END AS profitRate FROM fortune_finance_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND book_id = #{bookId} AND type IN (2, 3) AND status = 1000 AND submit_time >= #{query.startDate} AND submit_time <= CONCAT(#{query.endDate}, ' 23:59:59') ORDER BY submit_time DESC, order_id DESC

SELECT order_id AS orderId, title, COALESCE(out_amount, 0) AS outAmount, COALESCE(in_amount, 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(in_amount, 0) - COALESCE(out_amount, 0) AS profit, CASE WHEN COALESCE(out_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST((COALESCE(in_amount, 0) - COALESCE(out_amount, 0)) AS REAL) / out_amount * 100 END AS profitRate FROM fortune_finance_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND book_id = #{bookId} AND type IN (2, 3) AND status = 1000 AND submit_time >= #{query.startDate} AND submit_time <= #{query.endDate} || ' 23:59:59' ORDER BY submit_time DESC, order_id DESC
